subject: Console nudges v1 — launch timing + feature flag / rollback confirmation
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Console nudges v1 — launch timing + feature flag / rollback confirmation

Hey Ben + Tyler,

Want to lock timing for Console Nudges v1 (checklist + 2 banners) so we’re aligned with the lifecycle sprint launch.

Proposed:
- Launch window: Tue 1/14, 10:00–11:00am PT
- Scope: checklist component + 2 banners (missing API key / first request)
- Targeting: only net-new workspaces created after launch (no retroactive nags for existing activated users)
- Experiment: 90/10 (nudge vs holdout) if we’re comfortable; otherwise we can do 50/50 for faster read

Before I give a go in the sprint tracker, I need confirmation on:
1) Feature flag name + location (and who can flip it)
2) Rollback steps (kill-switch + any cached UI state to clear)
3) Any known gotchas on performance (Console load / dashboard render)

If it helps, these are the tickets/PRs we’re tying to:
- PM-414: scope + acceptance criteria
- ENG-2842 / PR 8941: experiment assignment middleware
- ENG-2843 / PR 8938: checklist + banners (behind flag)

Tyler — for attribution, do you need the exact timestamp we flip the flag to align with UTM capture windows?

Camila — FYI, this is the last dependency before we start the week 1 launch checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa
Product Lead, Console
Redwood Inference


From: Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 9:34 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudges v1 — launch timing + feature flag / rollback confirmation

Yes please on exact flip time (to the minute, PT is fine).

Two other asks from my side:
- Confirm whether “net-new workspaces only” is enforced via event-time or workspace_created_at (we’ve had off-by-one issues in past experiments)
- If we’re doing 90/10, I want to make sure we can still see guardrails (support-link clicks, banner dismissals) at reasonable volume

If you can send me the final flag key + experiment key, I’ll update the attribution join logic to be explicit.

Tyler
Marketing Ops & Attribution


From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 10:02 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudges v1 — launch timing + feature flag / rollback confirmation

+1 to Tue morning.

Marketing side:
- Email v1 “Welcome / Quickstart” is scheduled to start sending Tue afternoon (local-time send) to new signups.
- Would be great if console nudges are live earlier Tue so we’re not sending people into a different experience.

On split: I’d prefer 50/50 for week 1 so we can call it quickly, unless you think UX risk is high.

Marissa — if Eng is worried about 50/50 for safety, we can do 90/10 for 24h then ramp.

Ben
Growth


From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 12:11 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudges v1 — launch timing + feature flag / rollback confirmation

Got it.

Re: split — I’m OK with a ramp:
- 10% for first 2 hours (watch console error rate + perf)
- then 50/50 starting ~1pm PT Tue if guardrails are clean

Tyler — “net-new only” is intended to be enforced by workspace_created_at (not first_seen), so we don’t re-surface to older workspaces that happen to log in during the experiment.

I’m waiting on the final flag key + experiment key from Eng (should have it after today’s standup). Will forward as soon as I have it.

Rollback (draft, to confirm):
- Disable feature flag (immediate)
- Disable experiment assignment middleware for that experiment key (if needed)
- Confirm banners/checklist are not rendered when flag off (no cached state)

Camila — we’ll treat Tue 10am as tentative until I confirm keys + rollback with Eng.

Marissa


From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 9:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudges v1 — launch timing + feature flag / rollback confirmation

Confirmed details from console team this morning:

Feature flag / experiment:
- Flag key: console_onboarding_nudges_v1
- Experiment key: exp_console_nudges_v1
- Assignment unit: workspace_id (sticky)

Targeting:
- Only workspaces created after flag enable time (server-side check)
- Existing workspaces will remain unaffected even if they haven’t activated yet

Rollback plan:
1) Flip off console_onboarding_nudges_v1 (kill switch)
2) If we see bucketing bugs, disable exp_console_nudges_v1 assignment (separate toggle)
3) No DB migrations tied to this release; UI should render nothing when flag is off

Launch plan today:
- 10:00am PT: enable flag at 10% (nudge vs holdout)
- 12:00pm PT: if guardrails clean, ramp to 50/50

Tyler — please use 2025-01-14 10:00:00 PT as the start time for attribution.

Ben — aligns with email start this afternoon.

Camila — unless you object, we’re green to proceed.

Marissa


From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 4:38 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudges v1 — launch timing + feature flag / rollback confirmation

No objections. Thank you for tightening the rollback plan.

Please make sure we have a single place to report issues for the next 48 hours (and that Support knows what changed). Ben — can you post the “what’s new + escalation path” blurb in #general and link the tracker?

Marissa — please send a quick note tomorrow with: (1) guardrails status, (2) whether you ramped to 50/50, and (3) any unexpected user confusion.

Camila
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing
Redwood Inference
